nobitex.name: Nobitex (نوبیتکس)
nobitex.notes: size check = order notional (qty×limit_price), per-market (BTCUSDT ~0.6, ETHUSDT ~0.5 USDT); probe at near-market price with qty=notional/price. maxLeverage=5 all markets. positionFeeRate DAILY 0.05%→0.0083%/4h. fee_pct conservative (spot fee table not public). price_band wide (98% off-market accepted).
nobitex.api_notes: Public UDF endpoint: /market/udf/history (no token needed). Rate limit: 60 req/min. Official Python wrapper available.

mexc.name: MEXC
mexc.api_notes: No-KYC access is available but with strict withdrawal and trading limits for unverified users.
mexc.docs_note: spot_v3_en = LIVE api.mexc.com/api/v3 (verified 2026-09-09: 2080 markets, klines, ticker, depth). spot_v2_en describes the DEPRECATED /open/api/v2/* API (404 on live) — do not use; it made the AI extract dead endpoints (2026-09-09 MEXC wizard bug).

bitmex.name: BitMEX
bitmex.api_notes: API Key + HMAC Signature authentication. Full REST and WebSocket support. Offers a testnet environment for safe testing.

binance.name: Binance
binance.api_notes: API Key + HMAC Signature + IP whitelisting. Extensive SDK support in multiple languages. Testnet available.

kucoin.name: KuCoin
kucoin.api_notes: API Key + HMAC Signature + API Passphrase. Unified account trading supported.

okx.name: OKX
okx.api_notes: Unified V5 API. REST + WebSocket support. Highly structured documentation.

bybit.name: Bybit
bybit.api_notes: REST + WebSocket. USDT and USDC perpetuals supported.

kraken.name: Kraken
kraken.api_notes: API Key + HMAC Signature. FIX protocol support available for institutional traders.

coinex.name: CoinEx
coinex.api_notes: Client library available for both REST and WebSocket integration.

digifinex.name: DigiFinex
digifinex.api_notes: Open API access with a tiered VIP system affecting rate limits.

ethereal.name: Ethereal
ethereal.api_notes: Built-in TradingView UDF-compatible API for OHLCV data. Fully on-chain and permissionless.

hyperliquid.name: Hyperliquid
hyperliquid.api_notes: No account creation needed (connect wallet). No withdrawal limits. Handles ~44% of all DEX perpetual volume.

apex-omni.name: Apex Omni
apex-omni.api_notes: CEX-like trading speed combined with on-chain settlement. Offers copy trading via API.

asterdex.name: AsterDEX
asterdex.api_notes: Supports extremely high leverage. Multichain DEX architecture.

dydx.name: dYdX
dydx.api_notes: Low fees and moderate liquidity. Operates on an on-chain order book with off-chain matching.

edgex.name: edgeX
edgex.api_notes: Designed for permissionless, high-volume perpetual trading.
edgex.note: candles/ticker require NUMERIC contractId; symbols are contractIds

wallex.name: Wallex (والکس)
wallex.api_notes: Official UDF endpoint: /v1/udf/history for OHLCV. Python, .NET, and Go SDKs available.

exir.name: Exir (اکسیر)
exir.api_notes: Uses HMAC-SHA256 authentication with headers: api-key, api-signature, api-expires. Node.js and Python libs available.

tabdeal.name: Tabdeal (تبدیل)
tabdeal.api_notes: Official Python and Go SDKs provided. Unofficial Python wrapper also available.
tabdeal.api: docs unreachable — research could not build profile

bitpin.name: Bitpin (بیت‌پین)
bitpin.api_notes: Base URL: https://api.bitpin.market. Community-developed Go SDK exists.
bitpin.candles: NOT AVAILABLE in public v1 API (chart is TradingView-WS only)

ramzinex.name: Ramzinex (رمزینکس)
ramzinex.api_notes: Two API bases: publicapi.ramzinex.com (public) and ramzinex.com (authenticated with headers). Python implementation available.
ramzinex.candles: no documented OHLCV endpoint (pairs only verified)

ok-exchange-iran.name: OK Exchange (اوکی اکسچنج)
ok-exchange-iran.api_notes: Iranian CEX founded in 2017. Offers REST API and WebSocket data feeds. Supports 700+ cryptocurrencies.

blofin.name: BloFin
blofin.api_notes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 20,000 USDT.

bydfi.name: BYDFi
bydfi.api_notes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 50,000 USDT.
bydfi.api_docs: developers.bydfi.com Docusaurus; REST host not discoverable from docs

weex.name: WEEX
weex.api_notes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 50,000 USDT.

bitunix.name: Bitunix
bitunix.api_notes: High no-KYC limit: daily withdrawal up to 500,000 USDT.

kcex.name: KCEX
kcex.api_notes: No-KYC with a daily withdrawal limit of 15 BTC.

indoex.name: IndoEx
indoex.api_notes: No-KYC for spot trading. Withdrawal limit: 100 BTC daily. Supports 160+ cryptocurrencies.

houdini-swap.name: Houdini Swap
houdini-swap.api_notes: Privacy-enhanced swaps. Supports 100+ chains with no blockchain trace.
houdini-swap.api: bridge API, no candle endpoints documented

0x-swap-api.name: 0x Swap API
0x-swap-api.api_notes: Accesses 9M+ tokens across 16 EVM-compatible chains and 130+ exchanges.
0x-swap-api.api: 0x swap API v1 retired; v2 needs auth headers

eterna-mcp.name: Eterna MCP
eterna-mcp.api_notes: Built specifically for AI agents. Sandboxed TypeScript SDK with isolated sub-accounts.
eterna-mcp.api: MCP-based; no REST candle endpoints found

southxchange.name: Southxchange
southxchange.api_notes: Cryptocurrency broker that does not require KYC. Accepts Lightning payments.

vdex.name: VDEX
vdex.api_notes: Omnichain hybrid exchange. Features a darkpool and full self-custody.
